selected_work: VR_BACKEND_100_REVIEW_SET_05:F18 R107 MANAGED Texture2D mutation-source completeness for UpdateTexture/UpdateSurface.
summary: R107 closes the next R106 readiness gap by invalidating an already-current R105 MANAGED Texture2D CPU shadow when a successful D3D9 UpdateTexture destination or UpdateSurface parent texture resolves to that registered identity. The shadow becomes fail-closed/pending until a later successful LockRect capture refreshes it. The census and analyzer export UpdateTexture/UpdateSurface invalidation evidence while native draw remains disabled.

risk_review.reason: No protected R50/R51 D3D9 renderer ownership path changed. The generic src/vr startup risk path was reviewed, but R107 does not change device creation, Reset, Present, transport activation or selector flow. HMD/runtime correctness is not inferred from CI.

evidence: Result commit message contains exact controller marker [AUTO:CONVERSION-DX11-00070] and no CI-skip directive.
NativeManagedTextureShadow external invalidation clears active/staged capture state and marks the CPU shadow invalid without advancing its last captured version.

Successful UpdateTexture and UpdateSurface observers resolve registered target Texture2D identities and invalidate only a previously valid shadow; unrelated/unregistered destinations do not create registry state.
Hosted R107 probe proves current-to-stale invalidation, repeated fail-closed behavior and LockRect recapture recovery.
Analyzer compatibility remains backward-compatible because the R107 mutation-source summary group is optional.
No N100 clone/worktree, PC fast runner, Quest3/VDXR or in-game execution was used.
resume_cursor: R107 is automation-validated but runtime-untested. R106 readiness can no longer stay true after a known external UpdateTexture/UpdateSurface mutation of a registered MANAGED Texture2D.
next_action: Continue Set 05 F18 with one bounded non-routing managed-mirror readiness/ownership proof before any production SRV binding or native draw promotion. Preserve R107 invalidation semantics and keep runtime graphics parity HMD-gated.
